answer: A cheap sybil clone leaves a hollow identity: no bonded root, so its bids carry no weight. At the wharf, each agent must stake a bond tied to a verified hardware root before bidding on cargo. Honest agents broadcast a signed signal of stake and history, and peers attest only to those with skin in the game. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds, each slashable on dispute, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0143's threat model.
